answers.description: Cohere CAT+ machine transaltion specific model is build on top of the Cohere Command A+ architecture which is a mixture-of-experts with 24 active parameters out of 218 total parameters. The utilized multistep training protocol: coarse SFT focussing also on non-machine translation capabilities, specialized MT SFT, followed by DPO, RLVR and finished with small targeted DPO. We utilize its instruction following capabilities to assess error spans and quality estimation with a variant of GEMBA-MQM prompt.
answers.name: Cohere CAT+
